title: Nail Disease Pattern Algorithm
subtitle: Onychomycosis, psoriasis, lichen planus, trauma, and melanoma clues

steps.prompt: Single nail with longitudinal melanonychia, Hutchinson sign, splitting, pain, or rapid change?
Distal-lateral subungual debris, onycholysis, thickening, or tinea pedis?
Confirm onychomycosis with KOH/PAS/culture before systemic therapy
Pitting, oil drops, salmon patches, or psoriasis elsewhere?
Dorsal pterygium, thinning, ridging, twenty-nail dystrophy, or mucosal LP?
Trauma, eczema, paronychia, systemic disease, or biopsy pathway

citations.quote: StatPearls Onychomycosis review summarizes diagnosis with KOH, culture, histopathology, and treatment principles.
StatPearls Nail Psoriasis review describes nail pitting, onycholysis, oil-drop change, and differential diagnosis.
